# Requirements Quality Checklist: End-to-End In-Game Verification (Gate 3)

**Purpose**: Validate that the specification's functional requirements, success criteria, and acceptance conditions are complete, clear, consistent, and measurable — as a "unit test" for the requirements themselves.
**Created**: 2026-10-25
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements. Items test whether requirements are well-written, not whether implementation works.

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK022 - Are acceptance criteria testable (each AC has a clear pass/fail condition)? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §Acceptance Criteria]
- [x] CHK023 - Is the "In-game runs ≥ 1" criterion measurable with specific evidence requirements? [Measurability, Spec §Success Criteria Quantitative]
- [x] CHK024 - Is the "≤30 min" reproducibility criterion for the protocol specified with measurement method? [Measurability, Spec §Success Criteria Qualitative] — Measurement method specified in spec.md Success Criteria: start (open checklist) to stop (verdict written); inclusions/exclusions defined; self-timed wall-clock; over-budget recorded as deviation per IEEE 1012 §3.7.3. 30 min is project convention, not external standard.
- [x] CHK025 - Are all acceptance criteria free of implementation details (no Harmony, Postfix, etc.)? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §Success Criteria Technology-agnostic]
